my_stack_strength_hint_per_mass: Belirli bir ürün miktarında ne kadar etkin madde var? Ambalajda yazanı gir. Örnek: 1 g başına 50 mg. Doz önerisi değildir.
my_stack_strength_hint_vial_solution: Konsantrasyonu etikette yazdığı gibi gir. Örnek: 1 ml başına 250 mg. Flakonunda önce çözdüğün bir toz varsa kategori olarak “Peptit” seç — o zaman adım çözücüyü sorar. Doz önerisi değildir.

pk_stat_peak_sub: When the most active substance is in the blood after the last injection.
pk_stat_half_life_sub: After {{h}} h, half has been cleared. After {{h2}} h it is 75 %, and after {{h5}} h the substance is practically gone. The longer the half-life, the less often you need to dose.
pk_stat_tmax_sub: After the injection it takes about {{h}} h for the substance to reach its highest level in the blood. Only from this point are you at maximum effect.
pk_stat_bioavailability_sub: {{pct}} % of the injected amount reaches the bloodstream. For subcutaneous injection (SC) this value is typically high.
pk_stat_vd_sub: Indicates how widely the substance spreads into body tissue.
pk_stat_vd_high: High value — it is stored heavily in tissue, which often explains a longer duration of effect.
pk_stat_vd_low: Low value — it stays mainly in the blood.
pk_stat_ke_sub: Each hour, {{pct}} % of the remaining substance is cleared. Small value = slow clearance = long duration of effect.
pk_sim_subtitle: See at a glance when your peptide takes effect and when it has been cleared again
pk_sim_disclaimer: All values are based on pharmacological models and are estimates — not medical advice.
pk_history_hint: 7-day window with real intakes · swipe to scroll
pk_manual_intro: Simulate the theoretical course of a single dose — choose substance, dose and route. The values are estimates based on average pharmacological data.
pk_field_substance_tip: Choose the substance you want to simulate. The pharmacokinetic data (half-life, Tmax) is loaded automatically.
pk_no_profiles: No PK profiles yet. Add them in the admin panel.
pk_field_dose_tip: The amount you inject. Tip: check your active cycle for your usual dose.
pk_field_unit_tip: mcg = micrograms (smaller), mg = milligrams (larger), IU = international units (for HGH/HCG)
pk_field_route_tip: SC = subcutaneous (under the skin, slower), IM = intramuscular (into the muscle, somewhat faster)
pk_curve_sub: Relative active substance level in % (normalized to peak = 100 %)
pk_results_intro: What the simulation means for {{name}} — in simple terms.
pk_res_peak_explain: The maximum active substance level you reach with this dose — normalized to 100 %. All other values are shown relative to it.
pk_res_tmax_explain: After the injection it takes about {{h}} hours for the substance to reach its highest level in the blood. Only from this point are you at maximum effect.
pk_res_half_explain: After {{h}} hours, half of the substance has been cleared. After {{h2}} h it is 75 %, and after {{h5}} h it is practically completely eliminated. The longer the half-life, the less often you need to dose.
pk_res_duration_explain: Once the level drops below 10 %, the effect is negligible. This gives you a rough idea of how long a dose is actually active.
pk_res_f_explain: {{pct}} % of the injected amount actually reaches the bloodstream. The rest is broken down before it takes effect. For subcutaneous injection (SC) this value is typically high.
pk_res_vd_high: High value (> 1 L/kg) — the substance is stored heavily in tissue, not just in the blood. This often explains a longer duration of effect.
pk_res_vd_low: Low value — the substance stays mainly in the blood.
pk_res_accum_explain: With regular dosing at your chosen interval, the steady-state level is {{f}} times as high as after the first dose.
pk_res_accum_strong: That is strong accumulation — the substance builds up considerably.
